reference: Two episodes: The Return (S3E13 here, split S3E14), when Jim and Pam's prank of hiding his ringing phone sets him off and Michael has rebuffed him; and Angry Andy (S8E21), when he blows up at Nellie's office and punches a hole in its wall.

evidence.line: Andy: ...It's not funny! In fact, it's pretty freakin' unfunny! Oh, my GOD. [punches a hole in the wall] That... was an overreaction.
Jim: [inspecting the hole in the wall] Oh my God, that's half-inch drywall.
Andy: And your stupid face! [grabs Nellie's photo off the wall and smashes it] And your stupid office! [punches hole in the wall] Ah!
Darryl: He does not like that wall.

caveats: References that are not new punches: Safety Training (S3E19 sc.2) replays the clip in a recap; Beach Games (S3E22 sc.66) and Money (S4E4 sc.49) mention it. Citing these as punch episodes is wrong. The S8E21 punch is a stage direction only; also visual. Graded as fact with two required parts (both episodes).
question: In which episodes does Andy punch a hole in the wall?
